children.key: While drinking at the bar you took a glance at the news and something caught your eyes. It shows an image of a ship modified from a TK80C Tileart with six gigantic cannons in place of the cargo pods called Death Harmonica. The report say it is owned by the mad pirate Hawksparrow. No one knew how it came to be but it seems to pack as much firepower as the size suggest capable of taking down warships in few shots. It is reported that the ship along with a pair of modified Clipper escorts are currently terrorizing the merchants near Lesath. The Free Worlds is currently gathering ships to hunt it down but due to shortage of warships it can take months before they can properly respond. The local government have posted a bounty of 20M for whoever destroys the ship. The reward can be claimed on <destination>.

name: MGF: Ankulah Mlitgante Combat Sale

children.key: As you walk through the landing bay on the station you noitce a ship with [For Sale] sign on it. It appears to be the locally built Mlitgante without the tow system but instead two additonal gun ports at the front. It's condition is just average of the tow ships around here, some scratches, some repair marks, but nothing critical to its performance.

"How much?" You ask the seller standing next to it,  "6 million credits" he says. "That's less than half of what it would've been, condition is brand new, awesome speed and firepower. Best deal you'll ever get."
"Can you be more specific on the specs?"
"Well, I don't know the numbers but it out-ran a Marauder Quicksilver and beat the crap out of a stolen Gunboat a week ago. Pretty decent I'd say."
"Alright!" he hands you the key as you give him the credit chip. "Take a good care of her, there's only a few of these around." he walks off.

name: MGF: To Build a Beast 0
description: Buy ship building equipment and material at <destination>. To complete the purchase, you'll need at least 3,000,000 credits.

values: Buy ship building equipment and material at <destination>. To complete the purchase, you'll need at least 3,000,000 credits.
MGF: To Build a Beast 0: deferred

children.key: As you wandered the spaceport you hear someone calling out to you "Hey, you human over there." you look around and see a Hai approaching you, "Yes, you. You here to help us more?"
"We need resource, a lot of resource that we don't have. We want you to buy it for us.", he pauses, "Of course we will reward you well when it is done."
"What exactly do you want and what for?"

"Our fleet is too few and too busy. To buy, we do not have enough money, the few we have must be spend on development, construction, and infrastructure. Even so, the altered are weak yet vigilant, getting..." he pauses for a second, "Specific ship building resource in quantity can be difficult and may alert them. If you provide us the resource this will be a lot easier for us."
"Ok, and what exactly am I getting?"
"What exactly do you want and what for?"
He pauses for a second before replying "Things, weapons, maybe more if you help us more." he looks at a warship landing nearby then look at you.
"Ok, and what are you going to do with it?"
He thinks for a bit before replying "New ships, a bigger, more powerful ship." he says, "Your reward will be up to how much help you give us. It can be weapon, it can be more."
He thinks for some more, "We are expected build to only a few, but should you be very valuable to us I may be able to arrange it."
"I can wait, but not for long. Faster is better. I will find you here if you change mind."

"Perfect! Here is what we need." he hands you a paper, "You can buy it on Hai-home." you look at the paper and see a bill of materials listing all sort of specialized equipment and materials specific to building ships. "I almost forgot, my name is Tounei. We will have someone to help you when you land at Hai-home." he says. "You provide the payment and transport."
You went back to your ship and after a bit of looking up the price estimate you calculated that it'll cost you around 3,000,000 credits and 300 tons of cargo space.
You reached <destination> but you either lack 3,000,000 credits or 300 tons of free cargo space to make the purchase.

name: MGF: To Build a Beast 2a
description: Travel to <destination> to buy required materials for roughly 20,000,000 credits and at least 11,000 tons of free space.

values: Travel to <destination> to buy required materials for roughly 20,000,000 credits and at least 11,000 tons of free space.

children.key: MGF: To Build a Beast 1: done

You found Tounei along with a small crowd waiting for you as soon as you landed. They help you unload the cargo you just bought. As the last box is moved out of the ship Tounei comes up to you, "Thank you very much." he says "There is more that we need. I have heard that we may not be able to source from the fettered any more, I have plan for this." he says as he takes out another paper, "The rest we can get from human space."
"Ok, how much it's going to cost me this time?"
"We want you to buy us more ship materials to build the ship."
"Patience, it will be soon. We need time to work. Next we need more materials to build the ship."

He looks at the paper that he's holding for a few seconds, "My cost estimate is... 20,000,000 credits for one ship. You'll also need 11,000 tons of cargo space for minimum we need." he pause, "I believe human have ships big enough to carry that, yes?"

"Also, since you are already going to human space, if you can get any building equipment it will be great help, I hear you humans are building big factory ship." he says, "Those can be very useful to us too and it can help us work faster. Should you bring it, 3 will be enough."
"Ok, at least 11k tons of supplies and some factory ships."
"20M credits and ships might be a bit too much for me."
"This is much less than what you can get from the Fettered." he says, "Even so we can wait, but the longer we have to the longer it takes to get your reward."
"Alright, mind you it's going to be a long while."
"Perfect, this will greatly help us regain our freedom!" he hands you the paper, "I will ensure we have a reward waiting for you when you come to deliver us the materials."

You went back inside your ship and start looking up where can you make such purchase. Prime in Betelguese is the closest were you can get both the materials and factory ship although the commodity price will be significantly higher. Forge Station in Phecda is a lot cheaper but the trip is longer.

children.key: It doesn't take long for you to find Tounei, or rather for him to find you and find a place to sit and talk. "I tried to understand the codes of the humans. I may not understood it totally but I think your company should be for manufacturing and shipyard for best concealment and benefit to our friendship." he says, "It will be expensive to set up but I can provide you the expertise to defeat other human shipyard. Manufacturing simpler supply and component can also be set up at your place to free up our people for better task. Certainly we will reward you for your share of the work."
"Sounds good. Anywhere in specific?" (And show him the map for human space)
"I'm not sure about this, I want more time to consider."
"Sorry but I don't want to help you anymore."
"I understand. But the faster you decide, the better." he says, "I will be waiting here if you consider helping us again."
"Near the wormhole, but not too close to the Republic." he says "They have agreement with the Fettered and as far as I can tell they like to poke their nose into everything."
"The Syndicate may be our only option."
"The Free Worlds is quite far from the Republic."

"Where is that?" he asked, you circle the systems that belong to the Free Worlds. "Too far." he respond, "Close to wormhole I said. If you want to build shipyard there you may do whatever later, but our first have to be close."
"Then our only option is the Syndicate." you say.
You circle the area of the map that are under Syndicate control. Tounei looks at the map for a few second then point at Moktar "Here may work." he says.
"That's right on the pirate route, I don't want to deal with them. Also nobody lives there."
"I can deal with the pirates that often pass by but nobody lives there, the location is too remote and might draw suspicion."
"I see." he says, "How about here." He points at Mirfak, homeworld of Megaparsec shipyard.
"That's where Megaparsec shipyard is located and there's over a billion people living there. I'm not sure how it will work out."
"How about Bluestone in Bellatrix. There only a few people there and there is no existing shipyard, I'll have a lot more freedom on that planet. Should be cheaper too."
"That is perfect for concealment. Many people, existing industry and infrastructure will help you blend in." he replied.
"I'm still not sure about it. Bluestone in Bellatrix with only few people and no existing shipyard might be better. I'll have a lot more freedom not dealing with Megaparsec. Should be cheaper too."
"If you think so, it is your choice and I can work with that."

"Here is my suggestion for your first offering." he show you paper with a fairly detailed sketch of a ship. "I call it Cycloida, a freighter. The design should help conceal the cargo without being obvious to scanners and even engineers who do not dedicate their life to scanners. I designed it to use the same base material we require and share some component with our ship to justify purchase and production that will also be sent to us. And should we need to, we can purchase it from you and upgrade it to our standard." He seems very exicted to share this with you.
"How did you come up with all this so fast?"
"I did not. It is a design I made long ago but we could not justify building it. I only made tweak so it may be possible to be built by human technology."

children.key: You contact Tounei as soon as you landed and go to meet him at his office. You tell him that you picked to build the shipyard on <shipyard location> and give him the data of the suitable locations you found.

He look quickly look through the locations and picked one. "Here is good. I have a design ready to adapt to it." he projected his shipyard plan over the geographical map of the area and project it on the holovid.

The facility is massive to say the least, it's will easily be one of the largest on Sunracer and potentially the largest single building on the planet by volume if including the underground area. If you understand correctly this shipyard will be large enough to build some of the largest vessel to ever be built on a planet.

The facility is massive to say the least, it is easily the largest structure to ever be built on Bluestone on every measure. If you understand correctly this shipyard will be large enough to build some of the largest vessel to ever be built on a planet. You couldn't envision such project ever getting approved if this world is directly controlled by the Republic due to sheer environmental impact but such issue is of little concern to the Syndicate.
"This is way too large, we should start with something small."
"This is way too large, it will attact too much attention."
"It's huge for a first shipyard but I'm down."

"We need a lot of material, you will need it to be this big. A small shipyard with that buy too many will look suspicious the moment someone look at it." he says, "You can only hide for limited time, you have to conceal our operation with volume. They may look for your gold, but in a pile of others gold, they will not find yours."
He thinks for a few seconds, "You can count 10 acorns, you can see if 1 is missing, no one can see if the pile is 1000 acorns."
"It doesn't matter." he interjects, "Trust me. I will be paying."
"We can divide you a portion of our warchest when it is complete to help you. Come to me when it is done."
Looking at it a bit more you have a feeling that the design might be too obviously Hai so you made some suggestion to the outer appearance to make it stand out even less.

After a few hours of back and forth on some details, eventually you ended up with a single massive metal building housing 8 large dry docks that can be configured into a single massive one or divided for multiple smaller projects. Massive underground area for component production and stockpile with network of automated monorails for transporting both people and material across the entire facility. There's also several potential emplacement for turret and anti-orbit batteries that Tounei refuses to give up on and label them as machinery or experimental research section.

He also insisted on including several other self-sustainance features like hydroponics farm, and even a nuclear reactor to power itself. This practically make it a survival bunker. You can see this project being heavily questioned by the Republic but it may pass with the Syndicate. He load it into a data chip you gave him and hand it to you.
If you have to guess the cost of this project based on other buildings you know of, it'd easily be at least 1 billion credits if not more.
Now you have a plan to submit for approval, you can head back to <shipyard location> to continue.

name: MGF: To Build a Beast 10
description: Go to <destination> to meet with Mon'ari owner of i'Keer'ki company who will act as intermediary between your company and the Unfettered.

values: Go to <destination> to meet with Mon'ari owner of i'Keer'ki company who will act as intermediary between your company and the Unfettered.
MGF: To Build a Beast 9a: done
MGF: To Build a Beast 9b: done

children.key: You find Tounei as soon as you left your ship as if he was expecting you. You tell him that the shipyard is now complete and they are currently working to get the first ship into production. He seems very excited, "Amazing work captain! Now set up the logistic to send component and ship material to Makerplace and then we can-"

"Right, how much did it cost you?" he asked. "&[credits@mgf: tbab shipyard construction cost]" you say, "Just for the construction, haven't included the land price and other fees yet.". He seems shocked, "I may have miscalculated cost in human space..."
"However much you can, just give me that."
"No, I'll be in your debt. I will give you what I can right now."
"Follow me," he says. You follow him back to his workshop. After a bit of searching he put some credit chips in your hands. "253248900 credits is what I can give you right now."

Before you can utter a word he went and to look for something else. After a few minutes of him rummaging through a various papers he come back to you with a few in his hand. "These are technology design documents" he say, "I also include notes of my finding experimenting with the raider's technology as well. I hope your company can make use of these to help turn a profit." he hands the papers to you.

You take a look at some of them on the table nearby and you feel like you're seeing leaked top-secret documents straight from a lab in the Deep with a bunch of strange diagrams, graphs, drawings you don't understand, and all the letters are in Hai language.
"Are you sure you can give me these?"

He seems a little confused, "Yes. I have decided so. You have committed to helping us, I will do the same. I also believe that your specie maybe able to look at things in a different way and should they make any improvment we can both benefit "
"Also, I cannot read this", you say.

"Right. I will help you translate this." he replied. Tounei read the text in human language so you can write it. It took a while but you eventually finished it. From as much as you understood these includes everything from physics and optimization of a nuclear reactor to the tech behind their highly efficient pulse cannons, improved metal alloy, and shield regenerators. Additionally there's also observations and notes from disassembling the few Korath weapons and reactors You have no idea if he translated all of it correctly or even how true it is or if there's any missing link but your engineers back at the shipyard can probably figure it out.
"So about the logistic thing you're talking about earlier..."

"Yes, now about the logistic." he says, "We have our helpers with a front at Makerplace i'Keer'ki company, a supplier. Your fleet can drop off cargo with them, from there they can get it to us. You should go meet with the owner, Mon'ari." he hands you a sealed letter. "Say you're there for business, looking for supplier or whatever you think of until you can meet him and hand him this."
"Got it, I'll be on my way."

values: MGF: To Build a Beast 9a: done
MGF: To Build a Beast 9b: done

children.key: Landing on <origin> you eventually find your way to where i'Keer'ki is which isn't difficult at all, and to call them 'a supplier' may have been a bit of an understatement. The area of their factories and warehouses could probably be counted in square kilometers.

You find their office and managed to talk your way until you can meet with the owner, Mon'ari. You waited in a meeting room that, from little you know of the Hai architecture, the decorations in this room indicates it is quite old and could probably date back a dozen generations if not more. It didn't take long before Mon'ari arrives, from as much as you can tell about a Hai, he seems to be on the older side. You greeted and introduce yourself as an entrepreneur then hand him the sealed letter from Tounei. He unsealed and read the content for a few seconds. "Ah, another one of us, I see. Soon we will be buying supplies from you I assume."
"Yes. The fleet is still in progress but you should be able to expect ships from us in two months."
"Yes, but I haven't actually got a fleet yet. I don't know when can we begin."
"They can be here at your convenience. We have more than enough capacity to handle a few freighters, even human ones." he replied,
"Perhaps." he smiles. You thanks him for meeting with you and leave.

He took a gaze at each one of your freighter then takes out some credit chips and hand it to you. "I believe this should be enough."

The ground near the spaceport is visibly darkened as your fleet enters the atmosphere approaching the spaceport. As your <model> touch down you can already see Mon'ari arriving in a Hai luxury repulsor-craft. You leave your ship to meet up with him.

"Quite a fleet you brought us I see." he says, "Today is not too busy, I believe we can work it out.". The dockworkers and your fleet starts working on unloading as Mon'ari looks at your ship for a few seconds more, he then takes out some credit chips and hand it to you. "I believe this should be enough."
Checking the amount of credits he gave you, you figured he probably even overpaid you. "What will they be returning with?" Mon'ari asked looking at your freighters being unloaded.
"I was thinking about shipping some equipment back."
"Freighters are best when it's full." he says, "Returning empty means you made only half the profit you could have. I suggest you check the commodity prices to see what you like."
You quickly check the commodity price between here and <shipyard location>. It appears that you can make the most profit with equipment, not much but it's better than nothing.
"Equipment seems to be ideal." you say.
he nods, "We can help you with that.". "I'd appreciate it." you replied. "Then I shall arrange it for you."
The payment will be handled by your accounting team back at the shipyard.

You thanked him for the help, he nods, "Now I have other business to attend to, if you will excuse me." he says and return to his vehicle. Since you're already in Hai space you should check on Tounei to see what he's up to. Your cargo fleet meanwhile will be returning ahead of you and from now on they should be able to travel by themselves.

children.key: You see quite a few Altuella parked in low orbit surrounded by a few other ships, more than last time you've visited. You landed and went to find Tounei at his workshop. "I've delivered the first batch of components to Mon'ari" you say, "he will get it to you soon.". "Thank you captain. Once we receive it we should be able to mass produce it. This will be a big step for us!" he says, "I've told him to slowly deliver it in, it should be about two week until we will mass produce it."
"What are you planning to do after this?"
"Yes, you can visit our shipyard when it is available in two weeks."

"I have many to do, I also got something for you as well." he says, "I was thinking that it's difficult for us to communicate across the wormhole." he walks next to what looks like a boulder a pallet. He grabs it and pull it up with ease revealing what looks like communication satellite inside. "Concealed hyperspace relay" he says, "It is slow and can only communicate in burst to avoid detection, but it should be sufficient for us. I have made sure to make it similar to a regular asteroid in every aspect I can, you can drop it in a busy system and nobody will see it. I want you to deploy it between Allhome and Mirfak. It can capture communication from existing network and insert into it discreetly."

children.key: Arriving back at your shipyard you notice that the freighter prototype appears to be functional and were conducting test flight around the area. There also another two underconstruction within the shipyard. You're told that the Cycloida should be ready for mass production in 4 months, give or take.

You put the Unfettered communication device you got in your office and power it up. After a few seconds waiting for it to boot up and configure, you send a simple message to Tounei. After a few second you get a reply confirming it works. After a few more seconds he send another message "I have notice that you were sending me a lot of materials recently. How is your ship production.".
"We're still working on the Cycloida. There's already a prototype flying around."

"The amount of materials coming to us is too much for scale of what you're doing right now, you need to expand more to better conceal it. I will give you another design". He send a design for ship, this time a heavy freighter called Halicyne. "Build this.". You can probably split up the engineering team for another project but if this keeps up you will need to hire more.
"Our staff are already busy with the Cycloida."
"You need to do better to not attract attention from the Republic. Get more people if you need. With the success of Altuella I can also provide money if you need."
"Come to me next time you're here." he replied.

"Now I have to go." he says and disconnected. With that conversation ended, you head over to the engineering team and discuss the new heavy freighter design as well as potentially expanding the team. After an hour of talks they figured they could also start working on another ship along side without majorly affecting the deadline.

They're also down on expanding the team and have a few recommendations from Hephaestus, Chiron, and Rust, all major education center of human space. With the contacts they gave you, you can now head there to recruit them.
(Take note of the location and prepare to leave.)

"Also one more thing." <mgf shipyard headofresearch> who's leading the research on Hai weapon blueprint says. "I don't know if this is even possible but sample of the real weapon for the blueprints you gave us would greatly help."
"Sure I can ge some for you."

<mgf shipyard headofresearch> shows you the blueprints, looking at the blueprints again you noticed some minor details that seems different from the current one the Hai uses, perhaps it was for older generation but modern one would be just fine.

For outfits that includes Pulse Cannons, Boulder Reactor, and Hai Shield Regnerator that you can get from the Hai. There's also the metal alloy used by Hai which you're not quite sure if you can get individually.
(Have your export fleet buy two of each for the return trip. You estimated this will cost you 14,064,000 credits)

children.key: Upon landing at your shipyard, the head of engineering, <mgf shipyard headofengineer> personally come out to welcome the new hires. After a some onboarding process to get the new hires up to speed, <mgf shipyard headofengineer> walks up to you. "I think we're ready to mass produce Cycloida." he says. "After some ramp up and working out a few things, we should be able to get one out every 3 days. Which should be enough according to marketing team. Should demand exceed out expectation we can easily build a few every day even."
He nods. "We should be delivering the first ship in a week. As for the Halicyne, it's quite a lot bigger and may take us up to a year to get it to production but we'll see."
"Next I'd consider making as much of the outfit we'll need as possible." he says. "The big problem is the license."
"Well, we can try. Just don't expect it to be as good as existing ones on the market right away unless you manage to pull alien blueprints out from somewhere again."
"It's still a lot faster to get licenses and build an existing, well tested design anyway. So for now you should go purchase some commercial production license for it." he says
"Shields from Valhalla, atomics would also be neat if they even sell license for those. Ion engines and blasters from Hephaestus. Fuel Cell and battery from Rust. Finally anti-missile from Ada."

"I dunno. From what I've heard it's barely anything for the batteries, others I have no clue. There's probably a bit of upfront cost but I think most of it will be in royalties. It will definitely cost you less in the long run tho."
"Alright, hopefully it won't be too much."

name: MGF: Illegal Navy License offer
description: Go to the location written in the business card given to you by a strange man talking about Navy ships.

values: Go to the location written in the business card given to you by a strange man talking about Navy ships.

children.key: As you check out the Navy ship spec in the shipyard a person walks up to you.
"Pretty nice ship isn't it" he says, "Wish I could fly one of these without joining the Navy."
"Just another captain who's interested in Navy ships, like you." he says, "If you could own one would you?"
"I've heard rumor that they're developing new ones and it's quite something. You know how they even have contingency plan if Quarg ever attacks too."

He smiles and hand you what appears to be his business card and quickly walks away before you can say anything. Looking at the card he gave you, it seems to be very low quality but you also noticed the reflection revealing handwriting instruction telling you to meet him at a specific coordiate at <destination>.

_internalId: Mega Freight/Mega-Freight::MGF: Illegal Navy License offer

name: MGF: Illegal Navy License get

values: MGF: Illegal Navy License offer: done

children.key: You arrive at the coordinate and after looking around the area for a bit you notice a red blinking light coming from the top of a tree. You approach it and it appears to be a camouflaged ship, guessing from the profile it may be a Navy Frigate. Landing next to it you saw the person who handed you the business card coming out from the ship walking towards you.
(Exit your ship but stay close to it.)
"Come out here, we can't talk like this" he shouts then take a card out of his pocket waving it. "Navy License, want one?"
"Figured you'd want one seeing how often you visit that navy yard." he smiles, "Now lets get to business, you want a Navy license, yes?"
"Trade secret, duh. Now you want this or not?"
"Fill this, 10 million creds and it's yours." he says. You look at the paper he want you to fill and it appears to be a navy application form.
"Does this include Cruiser and Carrier license?"
(Fill the form and hand him the money.)
"No, if you want all Navy licenses then it'll be 20 mil."
"Actually, just the Navy License is fine."
"Sure." he hands you the form. You filled it and give it back to him.
"Actually, maybe just the Navy License is fine."
He hands you the form which looks like navy application form. you filled it and hand it back to him.
"Thank you, now please wait a few minutes as we work." he walks back into the ship. After a few minutes he comes back out with the license you requested and hand it to you.
The license looks legit in everyway you can tell. "Not even the Navy can tell the difference." he says, "Not unless you do something really stupid, now enjoy."

description: Having declined the tribute, the leader of Scar's Legion has challenged you to a fight to the death. Defeat the <npc>, then return to <destination>.

values: Having declined the tribute, the leader of Scar's Legion has challenged you to a fight to the death. Defeat the <npc>, then return to <destination>.

children.key: You've located the Scar's Hideout, a massive asteroid in orbit around a gas giant. As you fly over the asteroid's surface, you spot an open blast door. They must be inviting you inside. It surprises you that a gang of pirates would be capable of creating such a base, as the materials and time needed to make something like this are immense.

"That's it, go away or eat dust." the communication cuts off.
"Fine." the voice sounds a little disgruntled.
"The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems." you say.
"Perhaps we will stop," the voice pause for a brief moment.

"Under one condition. We'd like a one time shipment of various Hai weapons and technology. The shipment should be as big as possible. I've seen the freighters those aliens have. They're massive. Load two or three up with the goods and we'll consider focusing our attention elsewhere."

You boarded one of the smaller ship you carried on your ship and fly it inside.
"Excellent!" the pirate says, you also hear  cheers from the rest of the pirates in the room. "But make it quick. Wouldn't want to keep us waiting."
You hear a large crowd of pirates respond with a cacophony of jeers and boos. Suddenly the crowd falls silent. "Well I'm afraid that just won't do."

Upon entering the blast door, it closes behind you, leaving you in complete dark. Suddenly, floodlights flash on all around your ship. The brightness of the lights prevents you from seeing anyone beyond them, but you suspect that there are a number of weapons pointed at your ship right now.
You checked your tactical scanner and it confirms that there are hundreds of armed pirates behind the lights.
"Who are you and what do you want?" a voice booms from a loud speaker. You press a button to activate your ship's external speakers.
"I'm <first> <last>, here to negotiate on behalf of the Hai."
"I'm <first> <last>, here to take this gang down."
The voice laughs. "Well too bad, because you're right in the middle of a hornet's nest. Fire, boys!"
The voice laughs. "Ah, yes. Those squirrels. I take it they've had enough of us plundering their systems. Boys!"

The floodlights turn off, revealing a large room with what must be hundreds of pirates with guns of various sizes trained on your ship. One wrong move and you're toast. "Please, Captain. Step out of your ship."
You activate your ship's engines to escape. The floodlights suddenly reactivate.

values: mgf: killed a lot of scars pirates

children.key: You keep dragging your ship around smashing anything that isn't rock-solid and fly into everything that isn't a crate of bomb until you hit some metal control box that causes the blast door to reopen. You escaped from the kill pit with minor damage to your ship and leave whoever survived that to rethink before inviting someone again.
You step out of your ship, and a tall man with a scar across his cheek steps forward from the crowd of pirates. Presumably, it's the eponymous leader of the gang.
"The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems."
"No. Scar is long dead," the leader says.
"Oh, so does that make you Scab?"
"The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems."
The leader grimaces. "I'll cut your tongue out if you don't watch your mouth."
You take a step back. "The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems," you say, attempting not to get shanked.

"Perhaps we will stop," the leader says with a smile. "Under one condition. We'd like a one time shipment of various Hai weapons and technology. The shipment should be as big as possible. I've seen the freighters those aliens have. They're massive. Load two or three up with the goods and we'll consider focusing our attention elsewhere."
"Okay. I'll meet with the Hai and see what they can provide."
"I'm afraid that I can't allow that."
The crowd of pirates respond with a cacophony of jeers and boos. The leader raises his fist in the air, and the crowd falls silent. "Well I'm afraid that just won't do."

The leader paces back and forth in silence for a moment. "Well if we don't get what we want, then we're just going to need to keep on attacking. Which means that your presence here is pretty useless."

The leader turns to the crowd. "How about a fight? To the death!" The crowd erupts in cheers. The leader turns back to you. "We fight in this system only. Just you and me. You attempt to run, my men hunt you down. How's that sound?" You attempt to respond, but before you can, the leader pulls his gun and aims it at you. "Run."

"Excellent!" the pirate says, which is met with cheers from the rest of the pirates in the room. "But make it quick. Wouldn't want to keep us waiting." The blast doors reopen, and you return to your ship to leave immediately.
